hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom AMM curve hook that integrates Euler Finance vaults for single-sided liquidity. In beforeSwap, it computes a quote against a custom curve invariant, takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from the paired vault, verifies the curve is satisfied, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all swap accounting — entirely replacing Uniswap v4's native concentrated liquidity math.
